capabilities: patch the built-in CodeMirror editor with Japanese word segmentation
enable word-by-word cursor movement and selection in Japanese text
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.13.8+ for the needed API feature; README is bilingual (English and Japanese) and the demo images are hosted externally.
intentEvidence: A patch for Obsidian's built-in CodeMirror Editor to support Japanese word splitting
problem: Obsidian's built-in editor has no Japanese word splitting, so Japanese text without spaces is navigated and selected as one long block instead of word by word.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on the chs word splitting module by @linonetwo and modified to Japanese version
For Japanese word segmentation, we used tiny-segmenter created by Taku Kudo

summary: CodeMirror editor patch that adds Japanese word segmentation for cursor movement and word selection in edit mode.
